name: UNICBench
intro: UNICBench 是一个统一的多模态计数基准，覆盖图像、文档和音频三种模态，并提供统一协议、确定性数值解析和分层报告，用于严谨评估多模态大模型的计数能力。
build_method: 准确真值, 确定性数值解析, 分层报告
modality: 图像, 文本, 音频, 多模态
intro_en: UNICBench is a unified multimodal counting benchmark covering image, document, and audio inputs. It provides a unified protocol, deterministic numeric parsing, and stratified reporting for rigorous evaluation of MLLM counting ability.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with UNICBench arXiv:2603.00595; official WeChatCV/UnicBench repository. UNICBench unifies counting across 5,300 images with 5,508 questions, 872 documents with 5,888 questions, and 2,069 audio clips with 2,905 questions. Curators establish accurate count ground truth, assign a three-level capability taxonomy and difficulty tags, and freeze modality-specific splits and matching rules. Evaluation fixes prompts, random seeds, and decoding settings; deterministically parses numeric answers; applies modality-appropriate matching; and reports exact success, absolute and squared count error, and stratified results by modality, capability, and difficulty. The paper evaluates 45 MLLMs under this common protocol.
